successful financing through equity and/or debt
no obligation to update forward-looking statements
risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe liquidity and going-concern risk, including immaterial cash, a $15.6 million working-capital deficit, substantial operating cash burn, and reliance on related-party and external financing. Management describes cost savings, commercialization, acquisitions, and revenue growth plans, but these are largely forward-looking and not supported by quantified forecasts. Repetition of the going-concern warning and extensive standard forward-looking-disclaimer language partially obscures the severity of the financing dependence.
